verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents user-configurable bucket lifecycle policies with Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload actions, which give users automated retention and deletion of stored data. The docs also describe managing objects in the Cloud Console and managing AI Object Storage buckets and policies via Terraform. However, the evidence comes mostly from changelog snippets and covers only object storage. missing for 10: provider-side data retention and deletion commitments (e.g., post-account-closure or node/disk wipe guarantees), retention controls for inference request data, in-depth lifecycle documentation beyond release notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
